about_the_game:
At Eternity's Hatch is a mystery puzzle adventure centred around an evolving time travel system. Stranded at sea aboard a 1950s research vessel in an alternate timeline, you must utilise the ship's time-travel abilities to uncover information, solve puzzles across timelines and alter the past to return home. As the game progresses, you learn the rules governing the time travel system involving multiple timelines and how to use them to your advantage, unlocking new abilities along the way. 

Through a layered mystery with puzzles tied to narrative, you will discover secrets about the ship’s origin, its captain, and his quest to the Greenland Sea in search of a supernatural anomaly that threatens humanity, playing your part to determine the outcome of the story as the immediate plot and uncovered backstory converge.

The game is designed for fans of narrative-driven, atmospheric mystery puzzle games, who are motivated by curiosity, love uncovering layered mysteries, and appreciate games that reward observation and thoughtful problem-solving.

Features:

  • Unique Time-Travel System – Switch between a looping 1955 and an ever-advancing 1992. Changing something in the past creates a new timeline and you can travel between these branching realities to use the different effects of your actions.

  • Nautical Mystery – Piece together a fractured story of a scientist and former WW2 sailor obsessed with the anomaly, a mysterious weather event that created time travel, and poses a threat to humanity. Your choices in how and when to act will shape the outcome of this story, exploring themes of fate, creationism, and whether the future is something discovered or something made.

  • Environmental Time-Travel Puzzles – Solve intricate, puzzles across time that require careful attention to the rules of time travel and help unravel the msyery.

  • Atmospheric World – Explore a detailed, hand-crafted ship in the Greenland Sea, a research vessel converted from a 1950s fishing trawler.

  • Multiple Endings – Shape you and the captain’s fate through your choices and actions, leading to different resolutions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD RX 6600 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
